verdict.rationale: GlitchTip accepts events from any Sentry-compatible SDK and aims for Sentry API compatibility, and its docs point to general setup instructions for "any Sentry-compatible SDK" (docs-1, docs-11, docs-47, docs-50). Community users confirm they send events through the existing Sentry client ecosystem, including newer reporters like Svelte (comm-1, comm-4). OTel support and the open-source codebase further open up ingestion (docs-56, docs-52). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the ingestion protocol or endpoints for hand-written custom clients, and any published API spec (the OpenAPI probes returned 404).
